coverage_notes: Bounded supplementary recall watch completed with 12 targeted web searches covering: only/sole/last/full-service grocery-store loss; storm/flood/fire/outage-related food-distribution cancellations; abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major service reduction; and official SNAP/WIC/EBT interruption. Fresh local and official/provider-oriented results were prioritized. No new qualifying disruption since the prior hourly check was verified. Previously known storm-related Food Basket warehouse closures on Hawaiʻi Island and the Martha's Vineyard Island Food Pantry weather closure were treated as duplicates and not retained. Resource directories, routine program promotion, unrelated weather closures, donation content, and generic benefit/inflation coverage without immediate access consequences were excluded.
